title: Quietly Molten Australian Chicken Casserole
description: A savory and comforting Australian dish featuring lemongrass and bonito flakes, perfect for a lazy Sunday. This egg-free friendly recipe is easy to make and delicious to eat.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1 minute.
Add the chicken breast pieces and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the bruised lemongrass, shaved bonito flakes, and sliced mushrooms, and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked chicken mixture and chicken broth, and stir to combine.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish and bake for 25 minutes.
Remove from the oven and let rest for 5 minutes before serving.
